newsitem.title: GERMANY: Integrata shares flotation 55 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Integrata shares flotation 55 times oversubscribed.

text.p: Shares in German IT training group Integrata will debut on the Stuttgart stock exchange on Wednesday at 70 marks per ten-mark share, the brokerage Baader Wertpapier GmbH said in a statement.

The flotation of 100,000 ordinary shares was 55-times oversubscribed, Baader said, and the issue price, when open trade on the Stuttgart bourse begins on Wednesday, will be at the upper end of the anticipated trading range of 55 to 70 marks.
Up to 50 shares was issued for every buy order, Baader said in a statement.

Integrata Training is a unit of Integrata AG and will be the first listed company from the training sector. It had sales of 49.3 million marks in 1996, up from 47.9 million marks the previous year. Net profits in 1996 were 615,000 marks.
Integrata AG will hold around 52 percent of the training unit after the flotation, while a further 15 percent will be held by employees and the remaining 33 percent will be in small shareholdings.
The shares will be converted into five mark shares over the course of the year.
